tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dbyangs can ma dkar mo'i sgrub thabs shes rab mchog ster bzhugs/

rmad byung mdzes sdug lang tsho can/ /snyan tshig smra ba yongs kyi lha/ /mkhyen brtse'i gter gyur tshangs sras ma/ /ngag gi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ / dbyangs can ma dkar mo sgrub par 'dod pas skyabs sems sngon tu btang nas/ rten bkram/ mchod pa yo byad bya rgyud ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ auṃ swa bhā wa'am/ shūn+ya ta dz+nyā nas stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du yi ge hrīṃḥdakar po/ de las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi mi shes pa'i mun pa bsal/ shes rab kyi snang ba la bkod/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid lha mo dbyangs can ma sku mdog dkar mo/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yon pas pi wang rgyud stong dang ldan pa dku g.yon phyogs su bstan nas 'dzin cing*/ g.yas pa'i phyag sor gyis brdung ba la brtson zhing*/ zhabs gnyis tsog bu'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa/ dar gyi stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs can/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan/ snyan rgyan/ mgul rgyan la sogs pa rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas spras pa/ dbu skra mthon mthing phyed thur du 'phyang zhing phyed thor cog tu byas pa'i rtse la me tog gi phreng ba dang zla ba phyed pas brgyan pa/ 'od kyi phung po'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i spyi bor auṃ dkar po nas thugs kar hūṃ sngon pos mtshan par gyur/ rang gi snying gyen du bstan pa'i nang du srog gi ngo bo aṃ dkar po'i nā da las 'od zer dkar po lcags kyu lta bu 'phros sna bug g.yas nas 'thon te/ lho phyogs rgya mtsho'i 'gram dri za dga' ba'i tshal nas dbyangs can ma bzhugs pa'i shangs bug g.yon nas zhugs/ de'i shes rab kyi 'khor lo la reg pas lcags kyus thebs pa bzhin du drangs nas shangs bug g.yas pa nas thon/ skad cig gis lha mo nyid dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ auṃ swa ra swa sti ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta pra tīts+tsha'i bar gyis mchod nas/

dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ rang gi sna bug g.yon pa nas zhugs/ thugs ka'i aṃ yig la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las snying gar lha mo'i shes rab kyi 'khor lo pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang gi sems nyid hrīṃḥdakar po gyen du langs pa/ mdun nas brtsams te 'dab ma brgyad la g.yas bskor du rim pa bzhin/ a ā nas aṃ aḥrnam pa zung re re dkar zhing gsal ba'i 'od kyis lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas mi shes pa'i mun pa bsal nas blo gros kyi snang ba thogs med du rgyas par gyur par bsams la/ bzlas pa ni/ hrīṃḥ hrīṃḥgyi nā da las mar me mched pa ltar hrīṃ yig gi phreng ba rang gi zhal nas thon/ lte bar zhugs/ slar yang snying ga'i hrīṃ yig la thim par bsam zhing*/ hrīṃ re re brjod pa dang de nyid mgal me'i 'khor lo ltar 'khor ba'i 'od zer gyis sdig sgrib dang mi shes pa'i mun pa bsal blo gros kyi snang ba thogs med du rgyas par bsams nas hrīṃ bzla/ bar bar du hrīṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems nyan rang sogs dang*/ mkhas pa thams cad kyi shes rab rnams 'od kyi rnam par bsdus te hrīṃ yig la thim par gyur par bsams la ci mang bzla'o/ /bsnyen tshad sogs dang rtags gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar yin la/ mthar yig brgya bzla ba dang*/ mchod bstod byed dam ma byas kyang rung bar bshad/ gtor ma 'bul na bya rgyud ltar byin gyis brlabs nas 'od zer gyis lha mo mdun du spyan drangs te/ swa ra swa ste hrīṃ gyi mthar a ka ro btags la 'bul zhing mchod bstod bya/ bstod pa la mang yang*/ yid 'phrog mdzes pa'i rnam 'gyur ci yang ston/ /tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho'i gdangs snyan 'bum phrag sgrogs/ /zab yangs mkhyen brtse nam mkha'i khyon lta bu/ dbyangs can lha mo'i sku gsung thugs la bstod/ /pad+ma'i bzhin la g.yo ldan bung ba'i spyan/

/mthon mthing ral pa phyed bcings thor tshugs can/ /rol sgeg nyams kyis mdzes pa'i dbyangs can ma/ /bdag la rnam dpyod spobs pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /zhes bstod gsol dang*/ bzod gsol/ gshegs gsol rnams bya'o/ /'on kyang sbyin sreg gi tshe sgrub thabs su 'byung ba dang cung zad mi 'dra bar byas na legs pas de yang*/ thab kyi nang du ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus su paṃ las pad+ma dkar po pad+ma'i lte bar/ zhes pa nas/ thugs kar hūṃ sngon pos mtshan par gyur/ rang dang dam tshig pa'i thugs ka'i hūṃ hū+iṃ yig las 'od zer 'phros lho phyogs rgya mtsho'i 'gram dri za dga' ba'i tshal nas lha mo dbyangs can ma skad cig gis spyan drangs spyan 'dren gyi tshe tshigs bcad sbyor bar 'dod na/ spos rengs bzung nas/ chu 'dzin dkar po'i glog 'phreng dra ba can/ /mkha' yi mdzes byed 'dra ba'i yid 'phrog ma/ /dri za'i na chung dbus na 'jo sgeg mkhan/ /ring nas brtse ba'i lha mo da tshur byon/ /auṃ swa ra swa sti ma hā ka ru ṇi ka e hi/ auṃ badz+ra aṃ gu sha dzaḥnas/ ghaṇ+ḍa hoḥ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur par bsams la/ mchod pa ni/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho dpag med na/ /zhes sogs kyis phul nas bstod/ /sby-in sreg gi skabs su lha'i bskyed chog la rang nyid ces pa'i tshig 'dor ba sogs kyi khyad par shes dgos so// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/dbyangs can ma dkar mo'i sgrub thabs shes rab mchog ster bzhugs/ -PAGE 120--PAGE 121--PAGE 118-
